did.abstract: The Congregational Church in Exeter, New York, was established in 1806. The church oscillated between being a Congregational church and a Presbyterian church throughout its history. The church dissolved in 1885. The collection includes meeting minutes and financial reports for the church council and the church society.

acqinfo.head: Acquisition Information
acqinfo.p: Materials were donated to the Congregational Library & Archives by the New York Conference of the United Church of Christ in 1979; no accession number.

custodhist.head: Custodial History
custodhist.p: Materials in this collection were given to the New York Conference of the United Church of Christ at an unknown time, likely following the church's dissolution. This collection was originally processed as part of the New York Conference records (RG0112) circa 1980.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: This collection was processed by Zachary Bodnar, August 2026, according to the rules of Describing Archives: A Content Standard.

bioghist.head: Historical Note
bioghist.p: The Congregational Church in Exeter, New York, was established in 1806. Throughout its history, the church oscillated between being an independent church adhering to Congregational polity, a Congregational church, and a Presbyterian church. It is unclear when these transitions occurred. According to Hall's Index of American Presbyterian Congregations, the church changed denomination to Presbyterian in 1838 and 1870. The church dissolved in 1885.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This collection contains two volumes of administrative records for the Congregational Church in Exeter, New York. The collection includes meeting minutes and financial reports for the church council and the church society.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Materials in this collection have been arranged into chronological order by start date.
